title: Transcript-driven silence cut (writes an EDL)
what_it_does: Takes a word-level transcript, trims leading and trailing dead air and long pauses down to a natural breath, writes an EDL (keep/delete ranges), a retimed transcript on the edited timeline and a decisions file; with --apply it renders the cut with ffmpeg.
when_to_use: First step of an edit when a transcript already exists; the retimed transcript feeds captions and overlays so they stay in sync after cutting.
why: MIT; the EDL plus retimed transcript is what makes later HyperFrames overlays line up. Uses the transcript's timing rather than the audio, so pair with the speech-gap probe.
